title: SB2305 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 4, Chapter 54; Title 39 and Title 40, relative to identifying characteristics of firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2024-01-31; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514142116 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/113/Bill/SB2305.pdf (LegiScan doc 2910658))
provenance.note: Draft as introduced (2024-01-31); no amendments in text read. Twin HB 2881 is on the same document. SECTION 1 only adds a cross-reference to TCA 39-14-134(b). New section number not printed.

operative_text:
SECTION 2 (new section, TCA Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13): (a) Except as provided in subsection (b), it is an offense to knowingly receive, possess, conceal, store, barter, sell, transfer, or dispose of a firearm that has had the importer's or manufacturer's serial number removed, obliterated, or altered.
SECTION 2 (new section, subsection (b)(1)): A law enforcement officer or law enforcement agency, acting pursuant to § 39-17-1317, to confiscate and dispose of a firearm that has had the importer's or manufacturer's serial number removed, obliterated, or altered; or
SECTION 2 (new section, subsection (c)): A violation of subsection (a) is a Class E felony.
